leadText:
Pokémon Craft (Japanese: ポケモンクラフト Pokémon Craft) is a series of paper-fold Pokemon craft sets by Jupiter Corporation, itself part of their larger Magic Craft series. Each entry came with a single-page with illustrations by Emiko Yoshino, an instruction sheet, and paper craft sheets for 3 Pokémon. There is also a sub-series of Pokémon Craft known as Pokémon Craft DX (Japanese: ポケモンクラフトDX Pokémon Craft DX), containing a longer manga booklet, 5 paper craft sheets, and an extra such as a diorama set. They notably depict an unnamed female character bearing similarities to what would become Leaf and Green. Additional sets under the name of Pokémon Craft Movie Special (Japanese: ポケモンクラフト ムービースペシャル Pokémon Craft Movie Special) were made available to promote the Pokémon movies.

For the Satellaview, the December 21, 1997 issue of the downloadable magazine "Tora Maga Daisakusen" included a copy of Pokémon Craft, which included a miniature manga about how to make a paper . 

Tora Maga Daisakusen had a feature about Satella de Picross from December 1997 and people who solved all of the puzzles in it had a chance to win a copy of the Pokémon Craft Electric Set.
